name: muon_neutrino

phase_0.boundary_condition: The electroweak symmetry breaking scale at 246 GeV that contains the weak interaction sector and defines the muon neutrino mass and coupling regime

⊢.justification: The uninitialized state before electroweak symmetry breaking where lepton flavor quantum numbers are undefined and the muon neutrino does not exist as a distinct particle

⊣.justification: The closed boundary at 246 GeV that contains the entire weak interaction domain fixing the W and Z boson masses and the neutrino place in the Standard Model gauge network

≻.justification: The forward morphism where a muon neutrino absorbs a W+ boson and transforms into a muon constituting a directed transformation toward a charged lepton target

≺.justification: The contravariant descent where a muon neutrino exchanges a Z0 boson and remains a neutrino preserving flavor but transferring momentum

⋈.justification: Sequential composition of weak vertices in a scattering amplitude such as neutrino production vertex chained to propagation chained to detection vertex

⊙.justification: Self-reference of the neutrino as a mass eigenstate that propagates unchanged the particle that knows its own mass and flavor quantum numbers

∈.justification: The flavor eigenstate splits into a superposition of three mass eigenstates with different propagation phases one state opens into multiple arms

∋.justification: The mass eigenstate arms recombine at the detector the weak interaction vertex measures flavor fusing the superposition back into a definite flavor eigenstate or a contradiction if oscillation is incomplete

⊤.justification: The affirmative arm a muon is produced and detected confirming the muon neutrino flavor identity through constructive truth

⊥.justification: The negative arm only neutral-current scattering occurs or the neutrino passes undetected refuting the charged-current hypothesis

⊞.justification: The paradice where the neutrino simultaneously holds flavor eigenstate identity and mass eigenstate propagation both T and F held live during flight a contradiction kept without resolution

⊡.justification: Permanent append-only record in a Cherenkov or scintillator detector that cannot be undone and fixes the interaction in the experimental archive

phase_2.split_input: muon flavor eigenstate produced at source
phase_2.fuse_result: measured flavor eigenstate conflicting arms rejoin to B when oscillation phase differences produce a superposition that is neither pure flavor nor pure mass at detection
phase_2.failure_reason: Tri-ancestral reconnection over a transformed object — closes

phase_3.void_description: Pre-electroweak vacuum no lepton flavor defined SU(2)_L x U(1)_Y unbroken neutrinos massless and indistinguishable
phase_3.true_description: Charged-current interaction confirmed muon track reconstructed in detector muon lepton number +1 verified flavor identity affirmed
phase_3.false_description: Neutral-current only or no interaction no muon produced only hadronic recoil or missing energy muon flavor hypothesis refuted
phase_3.both_description: Oscillation superposition during propagation the neutrino is simultaneously a muon flavor eigenstate and a mass eigenstate superposition the B state is the physical oscillation phenomenon itself

Charged-current production vertex nu_mu created with muon in pion decay or accelerator target forward morphism toward flavor eigenstate
Flavor oscillation fork the produced flavor eigenstate splits into three mass eigenstate arms with distinct phases
Propagation step for first mass eigenstate phase evolves sequential composition in Hilbert space
Propagation step for second mass eigenstate phase evolves different frequency from first
Propagation step for third mass eigenstate phase evolves third frequency component
Superposition held live all three mass arms coexist with the original flavor identity B state both flavor and mass eigenstates simultaneously
Neutral-current interaction vertex optional Z0 exchange on any arm contravariant descent preserves flavor transfers momentum anchors F-arm if EVALF absent
Charged-current detection vertex on T-arm W+ exchange produces muon EVALT deposits affirmative truth flavor measured as nu_mu
Neutral-current detection on F-arm Z0 exchange produces hadronic shower only EVALF deposits negative flavor not confirmed as nu_mu
Detection fusion mass eigenstate arms recombine at detector vertex flavor measurement collapses superposition to definite outcome T F or B
Permanent detector record Cherenkov ring or scintillator hit written to data archive irreversible fixation of the event
Event reconstruction chain raw hits composed into track energy vertex position sequential composition of reconstruction algorithms
Self-reference of the recorded event the event knows itself as a muon neutrino candidate in the dataset
Close the analysis boundary the electroweak scale boundary reasserted as the frame containing the complete interaction history

phase_5.ipc_mechanism: W+ W- Z0 boson exchange mediating charged-current and neutral-current weak interactions between leptons and quarks
phase_5.memory_mechanism: Quantum state vector in the 3x3 PMNS mixing matrix Hilbert space flavor basis production detection and mass basis propagation as dual representations
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: Hamiltonian time evolution e^{-iHt} for propagation unitary reversible plus Born rule measurement postulate at detection irreversible fixes outcome
phase_5.alfs_store: The Particle Data Group Review of Particle Physics the canonical reference for neutrino masses mixing angles cross-sections and Standard Model parameters

phase_6.cycle_cost: One weak interaction vertex W or Z boson exchange per production detection cycle propagation is unitary and cost-free
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: Coherent neutrino flavor state at production vertex with definite muon lepton number
phase_6.post_cycle_state: Decohered detection record muon track or hadronic shower plus updated oscillation phase knowledge global quantum state remains pure
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 unitary propagation conserves von Neumann entropy measurement increases thermodynamic entropy in the detector but quantum information is conserved in the global system-environment state

grounding_reasoning:
⊣=𐑡: The muon neutrino participates in weak interactions as a node in the Standard Model's gauge network, connecting to the muon, W/Z bosons, and other leptons through a mixed connectivity of charged-current and neutral-current vertices without hierarchical containment or cyclic closure.
⊢=𐑼: The muon neutrino operates as a point-like quantum particle with no internal spatial extent, its interactions localized to single vertices in Feynman diagrams where constraint propagation occurs at a discrete point.
⊞=𐑳: The muon neutrino participates in weak interactions with asymmetric stoichiometry, such as one neutrino coupling to one muon and one W boson vertex, or scattering off a target with unequal particle counts before and after the interaction.
⊡=𐑴: The muon neutrino carries a conserved lepton flavor number (muon lepton number) that cannot change without a discrete weak interaction vertex, making its role Z2-protected against continuous deformation to a trivial state.
⊙=𐑢: The muon neutrino operates in the subcritical regime of the Standard Model, with finite mass and coupling constants that produce no scale-free correlations or divergent susceptibilities at low energies.
⊥=𐑖: The muon neutrino exhibits persistent chirality with structurally enforced left-handed helicity (and right-handed for antineutrinos) across all weak interaction vertices, a fixed symmetry breaking that cannot be thermally flipped and persists as an intrinsic property across multiple interaction axes.
≻=𐑑: The muon neutrino engages in weak interactions through W/Z boson exchange that irreversibly transforms particle identities (e.g., neutrino to muon, neutron to proton), constituting a structural transformation of the quantum state rather than a reversible association.
≺=𐑿: The muon neutrino carries a signed lepton flavor quantum number (+1 muon lepton number) that acts as a single donating pole in weak interactions, with its antineutrino counterpart providing the opposite accepting pole, establishing a clear directional character without self-complementarity.
⋈=𐑞: The muon neutrino's weak interaction cross-section is extremely small and highly context-dependent, requiring specific energy/momentum conditions and target availability for reliable detection, yielding medium information transmission per interaction event.
⊤=𐑧: The muon neutrino's flavor identity is kinetically frozen at low energies, requiring high-momentum weak interaction vertices (external driving) to change flavor or produce its charged lepton partner, making spontaneous rearrangement effectively impossible.
∈=𐑲: The muon neutrino's weak interaction vertices are strictly local events in spacetime, with no propagation of correlation to neighboring particles or fields beyond the immediate interaction point.
∋=𐑠: The muon neutrino engages in weak interactions through a sequential grammar where the neutrino first couples to a W boson vertex, which then sequentially decays or interacts with a target nucleon or lepton in an ordered chain of vertices.
